snippet.title: Dungeon Idler - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The Dungeon Idler Demo is OUT NOW on Steam!

Jump into the dungeon and experience what we've been working on!

What can you expect from the demo?
-25 Weapons
-9 Armor Pieces
-9 Artifacts
-5 Spells
Crazy amounts of combinations!

Experiment with different builds, discover powerful combinations, and see how far you can go!

We'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback. Every bit helps us make Dungeon Idler even better!

Play the Demo NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4026520/Dungeon_Idler/

Join our discord community: https://discord.com/invite/z8HmR2kt
